raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "live in"
  role subject "the user's daughter Rodica"
  role location "Suceava"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "have"
  role subject "the user's son-in-law Petru"
  role object "a truck"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "travel through"
  role subject "the user's son-in-law Petru"
  role destination "Germany"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s4 stated
  relation "be at"
  role subject "the user's grandson Darius"
  role location "the high school in Radauti"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s5 stated
  relation "live in"
  role subject "the user"
  role location "Vorona"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  select ?p
  rank highest ?d
  where all
    match
      relation "be at distance"
      role subject ?p
      role object ?d
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be one of"
      role subject ?p
      role object ?x
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  compare ?x equal "Rodica", "Petru", "Darius"
